name: Letter of Intent for KM3NeT 2.0
notes: arXiv submission 2016-01-27; published as J. Phys. G 43 (2016) 084001 in August 2016. Date field records the arXiv preprint month; the journal publication month is noted here rather than in 'date' to avoid overstating precision the record itself does not carry in one place.

summary.plain: The founding planning document for KM3NeT 2.0: the collaboration's proposal to build a network of deep-sea neutrino telescopes off Toulon, Capo Passero and Pylos to catch cosmic neutrinos and study how neutrino types mix.
summary.technical: Letter of Intent for KM3NeT 2.0 (arXiv:1601.07459; J. Phys. G 43 (2016) 084001): proposes three deep-sea neutrino-telescope building blocks (115 strings each, 18 optical modules per string, 31 PMTs per optical module) at Toulon, Capo Passero and Pylos, two configured as ARCA for high-energy astrophysical neutrinos and one as ORCA for atmospheric neutrino oscillation / mass-hierarchy studies; describes Phase-1 funding (~31 M EUR MoU) and a target completion of ARCA and ORCA by 2020.
